entry.title: Unisa symposium weighs how AI is reshaping teaching, support and research
entry.summary:
Indibano yesi-12 yoPhuhliso lwezeMfundo yeNtshona Koloni yeUnisa ibize abaphengululi, abafundi kunye nabameli beziko ezihlanu, kuquka iYunivesithi yaseKapa kunye neYunivesithi yaseStellenbosch, ukuxoxa ngendlela i-AI eguqula ngayo ukufundisa, inkxaso yabafundi, ukuqesheka kunye noPhando. Abathunywa beve ukuba i-chatbot entsha yeUnisa eqondiswe kubafundi sele isombulula imibuzo esiqhelekileyo emininzi, ebikade ithatha iintsuku, ngemizuzu, into esihlisa umthwalo womsebenzi kubasebenzi emaofisini alithoba elazwe kuyi phondo yeyunivesithi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ingxoxo yetafile engqukuva yendibano malunga nabaphumelele izidanga abalungele ikamva kunye nokufundisa okomelezwe bubuchwepheshe idibana ngqo kwiNtsika yoKuqala kaWits AHEAD, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, kunye nomsebenzi owabelwana ngawo yiMzantsi Afrika wokusebenzisa i-AI ngokunembopheleleko kwinqanaba elikhulu.

University of South Africa (Unisa) · University announcement

entry.title: University of Alaska regents delay AI policy drafted with Claude after faculty backlash
entry.summary:
IBhodi yabaThembeli yeYunivesithi yaseAlaska ihlehlise ivoto ngomqulu wayo wesikhokelo wenkqubo iphela, i-AI Engaged, emva kokuba abahlohli bachasa into yokuba uyilo lwangaphambili lwabhalwa ngoncedo lwe-chatbot i-Claude ye-Anthropic. Ivoto ngoku iya kwintlanganiso yeBhodi kaFebruwari, ngelixa iBhodi yoNxibelelwano lwe-AI yeyunivesithi iza kunceda ngasinye kwiiyunivesithi zayo ezintathu ukuba zibhale umgaqo-nkqubo wayo wekhampasi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ingxabano le ibonisa ukuba i-AI ngoku ichaphazela ulawulo lweyunivesithi ngokwayo, kungekhona ukufundisa nokuvavanya kuphela, nesi sikhumbuzo esithe ngqo kwiNtsika yesithandathu kaWits AHEAD malunga ne-AI enembopheleleko, imigaqo yokuziphatha nomgaqo-nkqubo: amaziko kufuneka abonakalise ukuba imigaqo-nkqubo yawo yenziwe ngokucacileyo kunye nokhuseleko lwabantu olufanelekileyo.

Anchorage Daily News · Established press

entry.title: World Bank report finds South Africa's digital skills pipeline mismatched to job demand
entry.summary:
Ingxelo yeBhanki yeHlabathi eyenziwe kunye noSebe laseMzantsi Afrika lemfundo ephakamileyo nokuqeqesha kunye noMastercard Foundation ifumanise ukungafaneleki kolwakhiwo phakathi kokungaphangeli okuphezulu kunye nezithuba zomsebenzi wedijithali ezingagqitywanga, nokunqongophala okukhulu kwimveliso yesoftware, unxibelelwano, kunye nokhuseleko lwe-cyber. Ixela ukuba abaphumelele izidanga abaninzi kwimfundo yedijithali bagqibela besemsebenzini wolawulo lwe-IT noyilo lwedijithali endaweni yamacandelo abawafunayo ngakumbi abaqeshi, kwaye akukho ziko elinye elinoxanduva lokukhokela uhambo lobuchule ukusuka ekuqeqeshweni ukuya kumsebenzi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ingxelo le sisicelo esithe ngqo kwiNtsika yesine kaWits AHEAD, i-AI, ubuchule babaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka, kunye noguquko olunobulungisa: ibonisa ukuba ukuvelisa abaphumelele izidanga abaninzi akwanele ngaphandle kokuba uqeqesho luhambelana nedatha yemveliso yoqoqosho yangoku kwaye luxhaswe ngentsebenziswano yesizwe eyomeleleyo.

World Bank · Report, intergovernmental body

entry.title: Study at South African university frames AI and academic integrity as a governance problem
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwesizathu olunengqiqo olubandakanya abafundi 16 beziqu eziphakamileyo kwimpilo yoluntu kwiyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika egxile kuphando, olubhalwe ngu Stephen Mongwe, Geesje Van den Berg kunye no Patience Kelebogile Mudau, lufumanise ukuba abafundi bawuxabisa uncedo lwe-AI evelisayo kodwa banexhala ngokuxhomekeka ngokugqithisileyo kuyo, ubunzima bokwazi ngqo ngumbhali, ubumfihlo bedatha, kunye nokuncipha kokucinga ngokunzulu. Ukungalingani kwi ndlela yokufikelela kwizixhobo zedijithali kunye nokungacaci kwezilindelo zeziko kwachaphazela indlela abafundi ababesebenzisa ngayo i-AI ngenyani, into eyenza ababhali baxoxe ukuba ingqibelelo yezemfundo kwixesha le-AI yingxaki yolawulo olubanzi, ingekhona eyokufunyaniswa kuphela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Olu phononongo luxhasa iNtsika yoKuqala kaWits AHEAD, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ngobungqina bokuba ukuguqulwa kovavanyo, umgaqo-nkqubo wengqibelelo odibanisa i-AI ngokucacileyo, kunye noxanduva oluthe lwaba lwamaziko, kubaluleke ngaphezu kokuphela nokubamba abafundi abangalunganga, isifundo esigqithele ngalemfundi yunivesithi enye.

Journal of Ethics in Higher Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Wits professor urges South Africa to build its own AI capacity, not just import it
entry.summary:
Ethetha ne-SAnews eSan Jose, ngexesha lotyelelo lwe-ikomiti ye-AI ekhokelwa nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa e-Silicon Valley, unjingalwazi weWits kwisayensi yekhompyutha, uBenjamin Rosman, okhokela iqela lengcebiso elijonga kwakhona umgaqo-nkqubo wesizwe we-AI waseMzantsi Afrika, uthe uMzantsi Afrika kufuneka wakhe amandla awo e-AI kunokuxhomekeka kuphuhliso olwenzeka kwezinye iindawo. Ukhombisa iiyunivesithi, abaphandi kunye noosomashishini bezwe njengesiseko esikhoyo, waluphawula ukuba izigqibo ezithatyathwa kwiminyaka emibini ukuya kwemihlanu ezayo, ngengozi efana nokuphazamiseka kwengqesho kunye nolwaphulo-mthetho lwe-cyber, ziza kubumba ilizwe kwiminyaka emininzi ezayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yesithandathu, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, kwakunye nentsika yesine, i-AI kunye nokuqesheka kwabaphumelele izidanga, isibongozo sikaRosman sokwakha amandla e-AI ekhaya, esekelwe kulwazi oluselekho leeyunivesithi, luyavana nemishini kaWits AHEAD yokomeleza amandla oMzantsi weHlabathi kunokungenisa nje izixhobo ze-AI eziyilwe ezinye iindawo.

SAnews (South African Government News Agency) · Government news agency report

entry.title: Universitat Jaume I video: UCL researcher Melissa Bond on AI in higher education teaching and research
entry.summary:
Kwividiyo epapashwe yiYunivesithi yaseSpain, i-Universitat Jaume I, uMelissa Bond we-University College London uxubusha indlela i-AI evelisayo kunye nemodeli ezinkulu zolwimi ezitshintsha ngayo ukufundiswa kwigumbi lokufundela nophando kwimfundo ephakamileyo. Iqoshiwe kwinkomfa yamazwe ngamazwe ye-EDUTEC 2026 e-Castelló, udliwano-ndlebe lujolise kusetyenziso olunoxanduva lwe-AI kuhlanganisela bungqina, kulandelwa iimigaqo ye-RAISE, kunye nendlela izixhobo zophononongo ezixhaswa yi-AI zinokukhawulezisa ngayo uphononongo olucwangcisiweyo, zishiye ixesha elingaphezulu lempembelelo kumgaqo-nkqubo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yokuqala, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, kunye nentsika yesihlanu, uhlalutyo lwedata lweenkqubo zemfundo, isibongozo sika-Bond sokwamkelwa kwi-AI ngoxanduva, ikhokelwa bubungqina, siyavana nenkcaso kaWits AHEAD yokuba izixhobo ze-AI kufundiswa nophando mazamkelwe ngemiqathango yokhuseleko, kungekhona ngamadlala kuphela.

Universitat Jaume I (EDUTEC 2026 international conference) · University conference video

entry.title: US study builds a behavioural early warning system from ordinary online course clicks
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olupapashwe kwi-Issues in Information Systems olwenziwe ngabaphandi be-Georgia College and State University e-United States, lwakha inkqubo yesilumkiso kwangethuba yokuziphatha, ngokusebenzisa abafundi 32,593 kunye nokunxibelelana kokucofa okungaphezulu kwe-10.6 million kwi-Open University Learning Analytics Dataset. Kusetyenziswa iimo zine zokuzinzileyo, amandla, kunye nendlela abafundi abahlula ngayo amaxesha okufunda, imodeli ye-logistic regression yakwazi ukubonisa ngokuchanekileyo abafundi abaza kungaphumeleli ngesilinganiso samashumi asibhozo ananye ekhulwini, ifikelela ukuchaneka jikelele kwamashumi amathandathu ananye ekhulwini emva kweentsuku 30 kuphela zedata, kwaye kwamashumi asithandathu asibhozo ekhulwini ngosuku lwe-150. Amaxesha okufunda ahlelekileyo nahlukaniswe kakuhle anxulumene nempumelelo, ngelixa amaxesha okufunda ngamandla amakhulu kakhulu anxulumene nomngcipheko omkhulu wokungaphumeleli.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yesibini, i-AI kunye nohlalutyo oluqikelelayo ngempumelelo yabafundi, ukugcinwa kwabafundi kunye nesilumkiso kwangethuba, le modeli yesilumkiso kwangethuba esekwe ekucofeni okuqhelekileyo kunokuba sezixhobo ezitsha ezibiza kakhulu, inika iWits AHEAD isampulu esisebenzayo sokuchonga abafundi abasemngciphekweni kwangethuba kwiikhosi ezinkulu zekhompyutha kunye nezixubile kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

Issues in Information Systems, Georgia College and State University · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Office for Students and Advance HE report says AI detection cannot be trusted to protect degree standards
entry.summary:
Ngomhla we-11 kuNovemba 2026, i-Office for Students ne-Advance HE bapapashe ingxelo ethi Making AI Work for Students, esekelwe kubafundi nabasebenzi abangaphezu kwama-300 kwiziko ezingaphezu kwe-120 zemfundo ephakamileyo eNgilani, ababuzwa phakathi kukaJuni noSeptemba 2026. Ingxelo ifumanise ukuba uvavanyo olungagadwanga lusoloko lunokugqitywa ngomgangatho ophezulu kusetyenziswa i-AI evelisayo, ukuba izixhobo zokubona ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI azithembekanga ngokupheleleyo, nokuba iindlela zamaziko amaninzi zivela ekuzameni koomabona-kude babasebenzi ngabanye kunokuba zivele kwicebo lobunkokeli obuphezulu. Uqeqesho kulwazi lwe-AI kubafundi nabasebenzi lusahlukahlukene kwaye lubukeka njengolukhethwa.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yokuqala, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo: ukufundisa, uvavanyo nengqibelelo, oku kusisiseko sobungqina kulo lonke uhlelo kunokuba yimigaqo yeyunivesithi enye, kwaye isilumkiso sokuba ukubona i-AI akuthembekanga kuqinisa ingxoxo ebikade iqhutywa yi-Wits AHEAD, yokuba uvavanyo lufuneka luphinde lwenziwe kungabi kukugcinwa nje.

Office for Students and Advance HE · National regulator and sector body joint report

entry.title: Randomised trial finds course integrated AI tutor lowered grades and cut engagement for US undergraduates
entry.summary:
Uvavanyo olungaqhelekanga olubandakanya abafundi abangama-2,379 kunye nootitshala abangama-30 kwiyunivesithi enkulu karhulumente eUnited States lufumanise ukuba ukufikelela kumfundisi-ntsapho we-AI evelisayo odityaniswe kwisifundo kwehlise amanqaku okugqibela ngama-0.37 omahluko ojikelele, kwaye kwehlisa ukubandakanyeka kwinkqubo yokufunda ngama-0.90 omahluko ojikelele, xa kuthelekiswa namacandelo angenalo olu fikelelo. Abaphandi, ekhokelwa nguJing Liu noTracy Sweet, babika ukuba ilahleko eqikelelweyo yayinkulu kakhulu kubafundi besizukulwana sokuqala, kwaye baqukumbela ngelithi lo mfundisi-ntsapho wathatha indawo yomsebenzi wokufunda okukhoyo kunokuba awuphucule ufundo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yokuqala, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, nakwintsika yesibini, i-AI kunye nohlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi, olu fumaniso lokuba umfundisi-ntsapho we-AI ongakhokelwanga unokwandisa umsantsa kubafundi besizukulwana sokuqala sisilumkiso i-Wits AHEAD esithatha nzulu njengoko yenza inkxaso ye-AI yabafundi boMzantsi weHlabathi abanemisantsa yabo kwifikelelo nasekulungiseleleni.

IZA Institute of Labor Economics working paper by Jing Liu, Tracy Sweet and colleagues · Working paper, randomised controlled trial

entry.title: Google.org-funded AI Research Foundations programme begins training South African university lecturers
entry.summary:
Inkqubo ye-AI Research Foundations, exhaswa yi-Google.org, isungulwe eMzantsi Afrika ngomhla we-9 kuNovemba 2026 kwisifundo esiziintsuku ezihlanu sabahlohli baseyunivesithi kwi-Biomedical Research Institute yaseYunivesithi yaseStellenbosch, idibanisa izifundiswa ezivela eStellenbosch, eYunivesithi yaseVenda, eYunivesithi yaseMpumalanga, eYunivesithi yaseFree State nakwiYunivesithi yaseNtshona Koloni. Enziwa yi-FATE Foundation kunye ne-African Institute for Mathematical Sciences Mzantsi Afrika, ngekharityhulam eyilwe yi-Google DeepMind kunye ne-University College London, le nkqubo yoqeqesho lwabaqeqeshi ijolise ekufikeleleni iiyunivesithi elishumi zaseMzantsi Afrika njengenxalenye yomgomo omkhulu weeyunivesithi ezimashumi mathathu kulo lonke iGhana, iKenya, iNigeria kunye noMzantsi Afrika, eziya kuqeqesha abafundi abali-30 000 ekugqibeleni.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yesine, i-AI, ubuchule babafundi abafumene izidanga, ukufumana umsebenzi kunye nokuguqulwa okulungileyo, imodeli yoqeqesho lwabaqeqeshi, exhobisa abahlohli kunabafundi bodwa, ibalulekile kwisantya eeyunivesithi zaseMzantsi Afrika zinako ukwakha ngaso amandla olophando lwe-AI aqhubekayo, kunokuxhomekeka kwiintlanganiso zesifundo zixesha linye.

Innovation Village (AI Africa Intelligence digest), reporting the Google.org-funded AI Research Foundations launch · Technology news digest report on a philanthropically funded university training programme

entry.title: Guiding students to use an AI tutor well matters more than just giving them access, Chilean field experiment finds
entry.summary:
Uvavanyo lwasentsimini olukhethwe ngokungahleliwe kwikhosi ye-econometrics yabafundi bonyaka wokuqala kwiyunivesithi yaseChile, oluchazwe kuphepha lomsebenzi lwe-IZA Institute of Labor Economics elibhalwe ngu Sebastian Gallegos wase Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez, luvavanye umncedisi wokufunda we-AI othile kwikhosi kwiindidi ezisixhenxe. Ukukhuthaza nje abafundi ukuba basebenzise isixhobo ngaphambi kovavanyo lwesiqingatha konyuka ukwazi nokusetyenziswa, kodwa akutshintshi amanqaku ovavanyo lwesiqingatha, ngelixa ukukhokela abafundi ukuba basisebenzise ngendlela yotitshala, besebenza ngeengcamango ngokulandelelana, ngaphambi kovavanyo lokugqibela konyusa ukusebenza kovavanyo lokugqibela nge-0.22 yomahluko ojoliswayo kunye noluncedo olubonwayo nge-0.38, okugxile kakhulu kwimibuzo evulelekileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yokuqala, i-AI eveliswayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, oku kufunyanisiweyo, ukuba indlela abakhokelwa ngayo abafundi ukusebenzisa umncedisi we-AI ibaluleke ngakumbi kunokunika nje abafundi ukufikelela, ithetha ngokuthe ngqo ngendlela i-Wits AHEAD eyila ukufundisa oluxhaswa yi-AI kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

IZA Institute of Labor Economics working paper by Sebastian Gallegos (Universidad Adolfo Ibanez) · Working paper, randomised field experiment

entry.title: Universities clone lecturers as AI avatars to extend teaching support

category.term: United Kingdom, United States and Australia

entry.summary:
I-Imperial Business School, i-Harvard Business School, iKholeji yoNongendlu yeYunivesithi yaseColumbia, kunye ne-Gies College of Business yeYunivesithi yaseIllinois ziphakathi kwamaziko amaninzi anokwandisa isixhobo se-AI sootitshala ukwandisa inkxaso yokufundisa ngaphaya kwegumbi lokufundela. I-Imperial yaqala ukukopa abasebenzi ngo-2024, iqala ngoNjingalwazi David Shrier, ukwenza abafundi abakude okanye abaphesheya bakwazi ukufikelela kwinguqulelo yedijithali yotitshala wabo nangaliphi ixesha; i-Gies College of Business ngoku inootitshala abalishumi elinesibini abanokhokheliso lwelizwi okanye lwevidiyo, abahlaziywa ngokutshintsha ibhalo endaweni yokuphinda urekhodwa iklasi iphela. Uphando olwenziwa kwiYunivesithi yaseNorthampton lwafumanisa ukuba abafundi bayixabisile le nkxaso kodwa bexhalabile ngokuphulukana noqhagamshelwano lobuntu, kwaza kwacetyiswa ukuba kubekho ukhuseleko olunokulungiswa olunika imibuzo enobuchule kumsebenzi oluntu.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yokuqala ye-Wits AHEAD, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, lo mba ubonisa itekhnoloji ihambela ekufuzeni ootitshala ngelizwi labo ngqo, ivela kwi-chatbot nje; ukhuseleko olusel' ekhona ezi ziko, nangona kubandakanya ukuthumela imibuzo ebucayi kumntu, lunika iifundo zexabiso kwinoma iziko elicinga ukuthatha inyathelo elifanayo.

Times Higher Education · Established press

entry.title: AI-detection tools keep flagging non-native English writers as cheats, researchers warn

category.term: Global, with examples from South Africa and the Philippines

entry.summary:
Kwinqaku elibhalelwe i-University World News, umphandi wezinto zobunzululwazi bezempilo uDavis Austria ulumkisa ngokuba izixhobo zokufumanisa i-AI ekuxhomekeke kuzo amayunivesithi amaninzi, zidla ngokuhlela gwenxa isiNgesi esibhalwe ngaboni abangenguzalwa belo lwimi njengento eveliswe yi-AI, ecaphula uphando ngababhali base-Mzantsi Afrika nasePhilippines abo mo wezivakalisi zabo udideka ngento eyenziwe ngumatshini. Uphando lwango-2026 oluvavanye izixhobo kwiithisisi zemfundo yomgangatho ophakamileyo ezibhalwe ngabo bangenguzalwa belo lwimi lwafumanisa ukuba i-Turnitin ayikakhankanyi ngqo nalinye kuma-phepha aveliswe ngokupheleleyo yi-AI, lonto i-Pangram yasebenza ngcono ngaphezulu; uphando lwangaphambili lwafumanisa ukuba ukufaka iimpazamo zokupela kuphela kwancipha ukuchaneka kwesixhobo esinye kusuka kuma-39.5% ukuya kuma-12.9%. Kwimeko ephononongwe yi-Office of the Independent Adjudicator yaseNgilani naseWales, ingcaciso yomfundi yokuba wasebenzisa i-Google ukufumana amagama afanayo, ngenxa yokuba isiNgesi asilulwimi lwakhe lwenzalo, yathathelwa njengovuma ukusebenzisa i-AI, nto leyo ekhokelele esohlwayweni samanqaku kwiziqu zakhe ziphela, isigqibo esagqitywa kamva ngumlamli ukuba asinaxhaso bungqina.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yesithandathu ye-Wits AHEAD, ukulingana kwi-AI enembopheleleko, lo mba ukhumbuza ngamandla ukuba izixhobo zokufumanisa eziqeqeshwe ikakhulu ngesiNgesi sabazalwayo zinganika isohlwayo esinzulu ngakumbi kubafundi bawoMzantsi weHlabathi ngqo, kananjalo nokuba inqaku lesixhobo kufuneka livule incoko nomfundi kunokuma ngalinye njengobungqina.

University World News · Established press (commentary citing peer-reviewed research)

entry.title: East African Community adopts a regional AI strategy with universities at its centre

category.term: East Africa (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan)

entry.summary:
Ooenzakusebenza bezemfundo be-East African Community (i-EAC) baye bavuma isicwangciso sommandla ngobukrelekrele bokwenziwa (i-AI) kwintlanganiso ye-21st Sectoral Council eKampala, eyabanjwa ukusuka ngomhla wesi-27 ukusa kowesi-31 kweyeDwarha 2026, bevuma imodyuli esisiseko ye-AI yabafundi bomgangatho wokuqala kunoma luluphi uhlobo lwezifundo, kunye noMsebenzisano Wommandla Wezikolo Eziphakamileyo we-AI uza kuhlanganisa ukufundisa, uphando kunye nokusungula okutsha kwe-AI kuwo wonke lo mmandla. I-Inter-University Council for East Africa ngoku ifanele yenze isicwangciso sokuphumeza imodyuli, amaziko alungele angayilinga kuqala, kwaza izixhobo ezintathu ezitsha zaza kukhokela uqeqesho lootitshala, umgaqo-nkqubo wamaziko kunye nemithetho yokuziphatha. Kwi-Ayre AI readiness index entsha ye-Commonwealth, i-Kenya, i-Uganda, i-Tanzania ne-Rwanda zonke zaphumelele ngaphantsi komda wokulungela, ngelixa i-Kenya iphumelele ngobunzima kunazo zonke kwi-48.7 kwikhulu.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yesihlanu ye-Wits AHEAD, uhlalutyo nedata ebonelela iinkqubo zemfundo, lo ngomnye weemanyano zommandla zokuqala eziguqula isicwangciso se-AI ibe ngumsebenzi ocacileyo wekharityhulam yeziko lemfundo ephakamileyo kunye nomsebenzisano owabelwana ngawo, kunokushiya iziko ngalinye lisebenza ngalinye.

TechTrendsKE · Intergovernmental body (reported by specialist technology press)

entry.title: Google DeepMind and Fab AI to build open AI tools for African teachers
entry.summary:
I-Google DeepMind kunye nombutho ongenzi nzuzo i-Fab AI, oxhaswa ngokubambisana nguGoogle.org kunye ne-Gates Foundation, uza kusebenzisana nabasunguli bendawo e-Kenya, eGhana nase-South Africa ukwakha izixhobo zootitshala ezisekwe kwimodeli ezivulekileyo zeGemma, zokucwangcisa izifundo, impendulo yovavanyo kunye nokuqeqeshwa kokufundisa, ezisebenza ezixhobeni ezingabizi kwaza zilungiselelwe iilwimi kunye nekharityhulam yendawo. Isigaba sokuqala sijolise ekufikeleleni ootitshala abafikelela kuma-500 kunye nabafundi abafikelela kuma-15 000, ngelixa idatha, izixhobo zovavanyo kunye neemodeli eziphumileyo zizakwabelwana esidlangalaleni ukwenzela ukuba abanye bazilungelelanise. Uthotho lwemfundo kubatitshala lwesimahla lweGoogle luyandiswa kwalo mmandla, luqala eMzantsi Afrika noMbutho wootitshala baseMzantsi Afrika ngaphambi kokufikela eNigeria, eKenya naseGhana ngonyaka ka-2027.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yesithathu, i-AI kunye nohlalutyo kwi-STEM kunye nemfundo yootitshala, iimodeli ezivulekileyo ezakhelwe iilwimi nekharityhulam yendawo zibaluleke ngakumbi kukhulisa kuMzantsi weHlabathi kunesixhobo nasiphi na esinelayisenisi enye.

entry.title: Universities push AI firms to be more transparent on costs
entry.summary:
Umbutho wesebe laseBritane iJisc, oxhaswa yiUniversities UK kunye neGuild HE, ukhuphe isibheno kubaphuhlisi becela iinkampani ze-AI ukuba zivumelane ngemiqathango efanayo malunga nexabiso, imilinganiselo yokusetyenziswa kunye nolawulo ngaphambi kokuba amaziko atyikitye izivumelwano. Iminqweno yawo elithandathu iquka isilumkiso ngokunyuka kweendleko okungalawulekiyo, ukuqhubeka ukufikelela kuhlobo oluthile lwemodeli apho ukufundisa okanye uphando kufuna ukuphindaphindwa, kunye nokukhuselwa kutshintsho oluphazamisayo okanye ukuxhomekeka kumphuhlisi omnye. Umlawuli welayisenisi ye-Jisc, uCaren Milloy, wathi amaziko afuna ukuqiniseka ukuba asalawula iindleko zawo, ukhetho kunye nomngcipheko njengoko ukusetyenziswa kunyuka.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yesithandathu, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo, lo ngomzekelo ongaqhelekileyo weeyunivesithi ezisebenza ndawonye ukumisela imiqathango kubaphuhlisi be-AI, kunokuba iziko ngalinye lixoxe lodwa.

entry.title: Case study of a Portuguese data science school finds generative AI entering teaching cautiously and unevenly
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olunzulu, olupapashwe kwi-Frontiers in Education nge-13 kuNovemba 2026, lufumanisa ukuba i-AI evelisayo ingena kufundiso kwisikolo sesayensi yedatha sePortugal ngokulumkileyo, ngokuzama nangokungalingani. Udliwano-ndlebe noongutitshala abasibhozo lufumanisa ukuba isithandathu kubo sele sazi i-AI evelisayo ikakhulu ngokuzifundisa, bane kuphela abafumene uqeqesho oluphuma kwiziko labo, kanti abasixhenxe batshintshile indlela yabo yokufundisa, basebenzisa yona ikakhulu ngokuba lube luncedo lokubhala, ukucinga iingcamango kunye nokubhala ikhowudi. Ukukhusela uvavanyo, ootitshala abahlanu bongeze imibuzo yokucinga nzulu, abane bafudukela kuvavanyo lwemilomo okanye ukhuselo lweprojekthi, kanti abathathu babuyisele uvavanyo olufutshane lobuso ngobuso ngaphandle kokunxulumana nenethiwekhi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika yokuqala ye-Wits AHEAD yi-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, equka ufundiso, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo yezemfundo; isibongozo soluphononongo lokuba kubekho umgaqo-nkqubo weziko ocacileyo, ixesha elixhaswe ngemali loqeqesho lwabasebenzi, kunye nokufikelela okulinganayo kwabafundi ezixhobeni ze-AI, kuhambelana nazo ezo nkqantosi uWits AHEAD azama ukuzivala kwiiyunivesithi zoMzantsi Afrika.

Frontiers in Education (Pereira and Aparicio, NOVA Information Management School, Universidade NOVA de Lisboa) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Universities across Asia-Pacific pair data science students with community organisations to close a data gap

category.term: Philippines, Hong Kong, Singapore and Japan

entry.summary:

Abafundi be-Chinese University of Hong Kong baguqule iingxelo zokuzinzileyo zamalungu angaphantsi kwe-1,900, ezaye zivaleleke kwiifayile zePDF ezizele ngumbhalo, zaba yidashboard esetyenziswa yiRoundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil, ngelixa iqela le-University of the Philippines lakha isishenxo-lwazi kunye nesixhobo sasentsimini esisebenza ngaphandle konxulumano, esisetyenziswa ngoku ngoluntu lwabalimi noloba 125 bezokuloba. Lo msitho waphawula ukuphela kwecebo lovavanyo leminyaka emibini, i-Social Impact Data Science Accelerator, elixhaswe yiMastercard Center for Inclusive Growth.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika yesihlanu ye-Wits AHEAD luhlalutyo kunye nedata kwiinkqubo zemfundo kunye nokuthatha izigqibo; lo nkqubela ubonisa imodeli enokusetyenziswa kwenye indawo, edibanisa uqeqesho lweeyunivesithi kuphononongo lwedata kunye nedata yangempela yemibutho, ekunokuba iWits AHEAD ifunde kuyo njengoko yakha amandla afanayo eMzantsi Afrika.

entry.title: South African ICT skills survey finds AI skills demand outpacing university and TVET pipelines
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwe-IITPSA ICT Skills Survey lwe-2026, olwenziwe yi-Institute of Information Technology Professionals South Africa ngokubambisana ne-Africa Analysis, olukhululwe ngomhla we-30 ku-Oktobha 2026, lufumanisa ukuba isidingo sezakhono ze-AI, iinjineli ze-AI, iinjineli zokufunda ngomatshini, iingcali ze-AI evelisayo, iinjineli ze-prompt kanye nagosa olulawula i-AI, sikhula ngesantya esigqithe amandla eyunivesithi kunye nee-TVET zoMzantsi Afrika. Malunga ne-80% yezingcali zeICT ezibuzwayo bathi i-AI sele yancitha umthwalo wabo womsebenzi, ngoxa abaphendulayo bebalula ukunqongophala kwamava omsebenzi, izithuba kuqeqesho, ukunqongophala kohlukahlukano kunye nokufuduka kweengcali ezinamava njengezizathu eziphambili zalo nqongophalo lwezakhono.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika yesine ye-Wits AHEAD yi-AI, ukulungela komsebenzi kwabaphumelele izidanga kunye nokuqesheka; isibongozo soluphononongo lokufunda kwindawo yomsebenzi kunye nobudlelwane obomeleleyo phakathi kweembaleka kunye noonyunivesithi buqhagamshela ngqo nesithuba phakathi koko iiyunivesithi zikufundisayo noko uqoqosho lwe-AI lwaseMzantsi Afrika lukufuna ngoku.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika yesithandathu ye-Wits AHEAD yi-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo; iziphumo ngokwelizwe ngalinye, umgaqo-nkqubo ongaphunyezwa eRwanda, ukulibaziseka kwikharityhulam eNamibia, iinzame ezingadityanisiweyo eGhana, zibonisa izithuba zolawulo i-Wits AHEAD ezilandelelayo kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

entry.title: Office for Students tells universities to bring back in-person exams to protect assessment from AI
entry.summary:
I-Office for Students yaseNgilani ibongoza iiyunivesithi ukuba ziphinde zicinge ngokubuyela kuviwo olwenziwa ngqo nolungavumeli iincwadi, uviwo lomlomo kunye nemisebenzi yezenzo, ukwenzela ukuba uvavanyo luhlale lusebenza kakuhle ngoxa ubukrelekrele bokwenziwa (i-AI) busanda ngamandla. Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ulandela uphononongo lweenyanga ezine olwenziwe nombutho i-Advance HE, olususelwa kwiingxoxo nabafundi kunye nabasebenzi abalingana ne-300 kwiziko ezingaphezulu kwe-120, lwafumanisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI kusanda kakhulu, kwaye ezinye iindlela zovavanyo azisalungele injongo yazo. Yeyokuqala apho umlawuli achaze izenzo zamaziko ezisebenzisa i-AI ezinokubangela ukungenelela, kuquka ukunikwa isidanga esiphantsi.

entry.title: Graduates' wellbeing and civic contribution should be tracked alongside pay, British Academy argues

Ikhombisa uphononongo lurhulumente olufumene ukuba iipesenti ezingama-24 zabo baphumelele izidanga zenza umsebenzi wokuzithandela ngokusesikweni ubuncinane kanye ngenyanga, kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezingama-17 zabo bangaphumeleliyo izidanga, kwaye icebisa ukudibanisa idatha yemfundo ephakamileyo kunye needatha zempilo nolwaphulo-mthetho ukwenza umfanekiso opheleleyo ngakumbi.

entry.title: South Africa ranks second in Africa on new Commonwealth youth AI readiness index, behind Mauritius

I-2026 Commonwealth Youth AI Readiness Index, eyenziwe yi-Ayre Think Tank isuka kwimithombe engama-1 128 kuwo onke amazwe ali-56 e-Commonwealth, ibeka uMzantsi Afrika kwindawo yeshumi elinethathu jikelele enamanqaku ali-56.8 kwele-100, kwindawo yesibini eAfrika emva kweMauritius (ene-64.4, kwindawo ye-8 ihlabathini). Le ndex iqikelela ukuba i-AI inganika uMzantsi Afrika phakathi kwe-US$4.7 bhiliyoni ne-US$13.7 bhiliyoni kuqoqosho lwayo ngaphakathi kweminyaka elishumi, kuxhomekeke kwimeko.

entry.title: Youth unemployment eases slightly to 47.3% as overall unemployment rises to 33.7% in the third quarter of 2026
entry.summary:
Izinga elisemthethweni lentswela-ngqesho linyuke ngamanqaku epesenti ali-0.1 laya kuma-33.7% kwikota yesithathu ka-2026, ngoxa uqeshwa lwanda ngabantu aba-101,000 ukuya kwizigidi ezi-16.8, kodwa umsebenzi usanda ngokukhawuleza ngakumbi. Intswela-ngqesho yolutsha (iminyaka 15 ukuya ku-34) yehla ngamanqaku ali-0.1 ukuya kuma-47.3%: ulutsha olungaqeshwanga lwehla nga-23,000 ukuya kwizigidi ezi-5.0, ngelixa ulutsha oluqeshiweyo lwehla nga-5,000 ukuya kwizigidi ezi-5.5.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Eli linani iqela elilisebenzisayo kwiindlela zabafundi abafundela ezidanga nakutshintsho olunobulungisa. Umba 4 ubuza ukuba i-AI iyasihla okanye iyasandisa esi sithuba kweli qela ngqo.

entry.title: University AI policies focus on cheating but leave data risks largely unaddressed, commentary warns
entry.summary:
Impawulo ekwi-University World News ithi iiyunivesithi zibhale imithetho ecokisekileyo yokulwa ubuqhetseba olunceda yi-AI, kodwa zishiya izikhokelo ezimbalwa ngendlela abasebenzi nabaphandi abanokungenisa ngayo idatha yeziko, yabafundi okanye yophando kwizixhobo ze-AI. Ikhankanya uphononongo lwase-UK apho ama-63% awezi-49 ziko lemfundo ephakamileyo asele asebenzisa isixhobo se-AI, kodwa ama-37% kuphela aphonononge imingcipheko ngaphaya komnikezeli waso osuduze, kananjalo ikhankanya ukuvuza kwedatha e-University of Osaka okuchaphazele abantu aba-77,851 njengesikhumbuzo sokuba umngcipheko omkhulu udla ngokuba yimpazamo eqhelekileyo yedatha, hayi imodeli ye-AI ngokwayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumba 6, ngendalo ye-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, oku kukhuthaza ukuba kujongwe ukuba ulawulo lwe-AI eziyunivesithi, kubandakanya nolo lweli qela ngokwalo, lugubungela ukuphathwa kwedatha, hayi ingqibelelo yezemfundo kuphela.

entry.title: Wits opens a Global Higher Education Futures Centre, with a dedicated generative AI pedagogy hub
entry.summary:

Iziko eli lihlelwe ngokusekelwe kwiindawo ezisithoba, enye kuzo izinikezelwe kwi-AI evelisayo yokufundisa, kwaye lichazwa njengempendulo kwinqwaba yeengxaki ezibandakanya ukutshintsha kwemozulu, umngeni kwipolitiko yamazwe ngamazwe, ukuphazamiseka kwe-AI evelisayo kunye nokungalingani kuMzantsi weHlabathi. Umsunguli weli ziko, uNjingalwazi Ruksana Osman, kunye nomlawuli, uGqirha Bernadette Johnson, bathi iziko eli liya kubeka phambili ukuveliswa kolwazi kuMzantsi weHlabathi kunokuba lithabathe iimodeli ezenziwe kuMntla weHlabathi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, iyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika iyakha olwayo uqongqo lokucinga ngokuphazamiseka kwe-AI kwimfundo ephakamileyo, kunokuba ithabathe olwenziwe kwindawo yimbi, nto leyo ingxaki yoMzantsi weHlabathi engagqibelelekayo esekelwe kulungelelwaniso i-Wits AHEAD ikhona ukuyixhasa.

entry.title: Wording of university generative AI policies shapes how students and teachers actually behave, study finds
entry.summary:
Abaphandi bahlalutye imigaqo-nkqubo ye-AI evelisayo yaziyunivesithi ezili-101 zaseMelika, baza badlulisela kubafundi abali-20 nabasebenzi abali-20 ukuba babuzwe ngendlela imigaqo le isetyenziswa ngayo ngempela. Bafumanise ukuba ulwimi oluchanekileyo lomgaqo, kungekhona nje umxholo wawo, lutshintsha indlela abafundi abaziphatha ngayo: umgaqo ogxininisa ekungathembekini wenza abafundi bafihle ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI ngoloyiko, ngelixa umgaqo ogxininisa ekuziphendulisweni wakhuthaza abafundi ukuba bavakalise obala. Ootitshala, kwelinye icala, bathi bathwele umsebenzi owongezelelweyo wokuvuma, kananjalo bengenayo indlela ethembekileyo yokuqinisekisa ukuba abafundi bathobela imigaqo le.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, lo phando sikhumbuza ukuba umgaqo-nkqubo we-AI evelisayo ulungile kuphela ngokulingana nolwimi lwawo: iiyunivesithi ezibhala okanye ezihlaziya imigaqo yazo yesebenzisa i-AI kufundisa nakuvavanyo, kufuneka zivavanye ingekuphela nto umgaqo ovumela, kodwa indlela abafundi nabasebenzi abaza kufunda baze basebenze ngamagama lawo uqobo.

entry.title: How deeply students engage with an AI chat, not how often they use it, predicts better coursework, large Australian study finds
entry.summary:
Abaphandi be-University of Queensland kunye ne-Monash University baphonononge abafundi abali-1 681 kwiikhosi zeyunivesithi ezili-40 ababesebenzisa amaqabane e-AI abakhelweyo kwimisebenzi yokudala izixhobo, ukulamla phakathi koontanga kunye nokuziqhelanisa. Bakhodinge iintlanganisela zeencoko ezili-829 ngokubandakanyeka kwengqondo baze bamodele iintolongo zemisebenzi ezingaphantsi kwe-3 000, bafumanisa ukuba abafundi ababandakanyeka nzulu nge-AI, kunokuba baxoxe nayo rhoqo, bavelisa umsebenzi ogqibeleleyo wophuhliso olukumgangatho ophezulu, nokuba baphosene imiyalezo emingaphi. Emva kokulinga okungachanekileyo, abafundi abancokolayo kunye ne-AI benza amalinge ambalwa ngaphezulu, kodwa bade babe nokulungileyo rhoqo xa bephinda bazama.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 2, lo mfumaniso ubalulekile kuzo zonke iziko ezakha uhlalutyo malunga nokusetyenziswa kwe-AI: ukubala ukufuthi abafundi bavula ikhetshbhothi kuthetha kancinci ngokufunda, ngoko iinqubo eziyilelwe ukuxhasa impumelelo yabafundi kufuneka zijonge ubunzulu bokubandakanyeka, kungekhona ukufutha kokucofa.

entry.title: Grade the process, not just the AI-era output, Bristol pro vice-chancellor tells student success conference
entry.summary:
Ethetha kwinkomfa ye-Times Higher Education ye-Student Success eyenzelwe e-United Kingdom nase-Ireland, uTansy Jessop, isekela-rektala yemfundo nabafundi e-University of Bristol, uthi iiyunivesithi zidlule kuphela ekugadeni ukusetyenziswa okufanelekileyo kwe-AI evelisayo, kufuneka ngoku ziyile uvavanyo olubonisa indlela umfundi afikelele kuyo kwimpendulo yakhe. Uchaze imeko yesayensi yekhompyuter eBristol apho izithuthi zokwakha iirobhothi zazidla ngokuba zivela kwi-AI ngokupheleleyo, nto leyo eyenza abasebenzi bagqibe ekubeni banike abafundi irobhothi egqityiweyo baze babacele ukuba baqikelele indlela eyakhiwe ngayo. UJessop uthi indlela le iya kunceda abafundi baphuhlise izakhono i-AI engenakuzitshintsha lula, ezifana nokunxanelwa kwazi, ukucinga okujulileyo kunye nentsebenziswano.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, oku kunikezela impendulo yangempela kumbuzo wengqibelelo yovavanyo: kunokuphila ngokuleqa izixhobo zokufumanisa i-AI ezingathembekiyo, kwakha imisebenzi ebonakalisa ukucinga komfundi kwaye igcine umgwebi oyintu kulo nqubo.

entry.title: AI-generated 'slop' papers published under prominent academics' names without their consent
entry.summary:
Iqela leephephandaba ezifana ngokubukeka lipapashe amaphepha aveliswe yi-AI ngamagama abaphandi abaziwayo, kubandakanya uJure Leskovec noFei-Fei Li base-Stanford, abathi abakaze babhale okanye bangenise lo msebenzi. I-Times Higher Education ixela ukuba iphepha elinye liphinde lavela ngegama lombhali owahlukileyo kwintsuku ezimbalwa emva kokuba laboniswa laza lasuswa, kwaye iiphephandaba ezi zahlukana umhleli omkhulu omnye kunye noonxibelelwane bebhodi abangazi ukuba badweliswe. Iiphephandaba ezintathu ezi, ezabhalisa kuphela ngo-2026, zibiza ababhali phakathi kwedola 10 nedola 200 kwiphepha ngalinye.

entry.title: Staff overestimate how much students use generative AI, Manchester study finds
entry.summary:
Uphando olwenziwe kwisikolo esinye sesayensi yoluntu kwiyunivesithi yase United Kingdom lufumanise ukuba abafundisi-ntsapho babukeza ngokugqithisileyo indlela abafundi abasebenzisa ngayo i-AI evelisayo kwizifundo zabo. Ngokusekelwe kwimibuzo eyenziwa kubafundisi-ntsapho abangama-45 nabafundi abangama-86 kwi-University of Manchester, abafundisi-ntsapho babukeza ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI ngabafundi ku-5.23 kwisikali esinamanqaku asixhenxe, okuphezulu kakhulu kunomyinge wabafundi ngokwabo ongu-3.11. Abafundi babonakala banethemba ngakumbi kunabafundisi-ntsapho ngokuphathelele iingenelo ze-AI kwimveliso nokufunda, bathi bayisebenzisa ikakhulu ukufumana impendulo, ukulungiselela umsebenzi obhaliweyo nokulungisa igrama.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 1, umahluko phakathi koko abafundisi-ntsapho bakubukezayo noko abafundi bakwenzayo ngenyaniso ubonisa isizathu sokuba umgaqo-nkqubo wokusetyenziswa kwe-AI evelisayo kunye nokuyilwa kokufundisa kufuneka kuxhomekeke kubungqina obuvela kubafundi ngokwabo, hayi kwimbono yabafundisi-ntsapho, ngokukhethekileyo ngoxa iiyunivesithi zoMzantsi weHlabathi zicamngca ngezicamango ezifanayo.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Habit, not enjoyment, drives ChatGPT use among distance students at the University of South Africa, study of 294 finds
entry.summary:
Uphando olwenziwe kubafundi abangama-294 be-University of South Africa, elona ziko likhulu lemfundo esemgama e-Afrika, lusebenzise imodeli ye-UTAUT2 ukuphonononga ukuba kutheni abafundi besebenzisa i-ChatGPT. Umkhwa yayiyeyona nto yomeleleyo eqikelela zombini injongo yokusebenzisa i-ChatGPT nokuyisebenzisa ngokwenene, ilandelwa ziimeko ezincedisayo ezinjengesikhokelo nezixhobo, ngelixa ukonwaba nezimvo zoontanga zingabanga nampembelelo ibalulekileyo. Imodeli ichaza iipesenti ezingama-69.2 zenjongo yabafundi yokusebenzisa esi sixhobo neepesenti ezingama-37.9 zokusisebenzisa kwabo ngokwenene.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 1, ukufumanisa ukuba umkhwa nenkxaso yeziko, hayi ubutsha bento, kuqhuba ukusetyenziswa kubonisa ukuba iiyunivesithi kufuneka zibumbe imikhwa yemihla ngemihla yabafundi nge-AI ngesikhokelo nangoyilo lwezifundo, ingakumbi kwimfundo esemgama kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Africa and Europe seek their own path on AI in science, with shared computing and genomic data on the agenda
entry.summary:
Kwintlanganiso ye-African Union ne-European Union malunga ne-AI kwisayensi ngomhla wama-26 ku-Okthobha, eyabanjwa kwi-intanethi endaweni yokuba ibe se-Addis Ababa njengoko kwakucwangcisiwe, uMaria Cristina Russo, igosa eliphezulu le-European Commission, uthe i-United States ne-China ziya phambili kakhulu kwaye i-Europe ne-Afrika zidinga indlela yazo. Izithethi zacela amandla ekhompyutha abelwanayo kwimimandla, isakhelo selizwekazi sedatha yemfuza nokwabelana ngeenzuzo, kunye neenjongo ezinokulinganiswa zabasetyhini, abamalunga nesinye kwisihlanu sabasebenzi behlabathi kwidatha nakwi-AI. Iingcebiso ziya kuthunyelwa kwintlanganiso yabaphathiswa be-AU ne-EU yophando nokuyila ehlehliselwe ku-2027, ngokutsho kwe-University World News.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 6, le ntlanganiso ibeka ubunini bedatha, ukufikelela ngokulinganayo kumandla ekhompyutha nokuhamba kwezakhono embindini womgaqo-nkqubo we-AI, imibuzo eya kugqiba ukuba iiyunivesithi zase-Afrika ziya kuyibumba na i-AI kuphando okanye ziya kuyisebenzisa nje kuphela.

University World News · Established higher education press

entry.title: UNESCO: university enrolment in the Arab States has nearly tripled to almost 15 million, yet youth unemployment stands at 26%
entry.summary:
Ingxelo entsha ye-UNESCO, i-The state of higher education in the Arab States, ifumanisa ukuba inani labafundi abangena kwiiyunivesithi kulo mmandla liphantse laphindeka kathathu kwiminyaka engama-25, lafikelela phantse kwizigidi ezili-15 zabafundi, nangona izinga lobhaliso, eliziipesenti ezingama-37 ngo-2024, lisengaphantsi komndilili wehlabathi oziipesenti ezingama-44. Abasetyhini ngoku baphantse babe sisiqingatha sabaphumelele izidanga ze-STEM kulo mmandla, xa kuthelekiswa nesahlulo esingaphezulu kancinci kwesinye kwisithathu ehlabathini, kodwa ukungaqeshwa kolutsha kumi kwiipesenti ezingama-26, phantse kabini umndilili wehlabathi. Le ngxelo, eyasungulwa eDoha ngomhla we-4 kuNovemba, inika iingcebiso ezilishumi kwaye iphawula ukuba ngaphezulu kweepesenti ezingama-70 zamazwe ama-Arab ngoku afaka iinjongo zedijithali kwizicwangciso zawo zesizwe zemfundo ephakamileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 5, oku kubonisa oko idatha yommandla ngemfundo ephakamileyo enokukutyhila: ukwanda okukhulu kokufikelela akuthethi nto ingako ukuba iinkqubo azilandeli ukuba abaphumelele izidanga bayawufumana na umsebenzi, uvavanyo olufanayo uMzantsi Afrika noMzantsi weHlabathi ojongene nalo.

UNESCO (IESALC and UNESCO Office Beirut) · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Deep Learning Indaba video: Vukosi Marivate on governing AI in Africa and what a degree is worth now
entry.summary:
Kudliwanondlebe lwemizuzu engama-36 olwarekhodwa ngexesha le-Deep Learning Indaba 2026 kwi-Pan-Atlantic University eLagos, uNjingalwazi Vukosi Marivate, omnye wabaseki be-Indaba, i-Masakhane NLP ne-Lelapa AI, nomnye weengcali ezingama-40 kwi-United Nations Independent International Scientific Panel on AI, ucacisa ukuba kuthetha ntoni ukucebisa oorhulumente nge-AI nokuba kutheni ulawulo lwe-AI eMzantsi Afrika luchaphazela onke amasebe karhulumente. Uthi ukuzimela kuthetha amandla okuzenzela izigqibo, hayi ukwakha yonke into ekhaya, ukuba i-AI ayiluphulanga uvavanyo kodwa iveze ubuthathaka balo, nokuba i-Afrika kufuneka isuke ekumkeni kweengcali iye ekujikelezeni kweengcali.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 4, imibuzo yakhe malunga nexabiso lesidanga kwixesha le-AI, nokuba ingaba i-Afrika iqeqesha abasebenzi be-AI abangabizi ukuze basebenzele amanye amazwe, ichukumisa undoqo wesakhono sabaphumelele izidanga notshintsho olunobulungisa kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

Deep Learning Indaba (YouTube) · Africa's machine learning community, official video channel

entry.title: South Korea vows to prosecute students using AI glasses in exams
entry.summary:
ISebe lezeMfundo laseMzantsi Korea lithi, ukusukela kunyaka ozayo, liya kuphatha ukuqhatha kuviwo lwesizwe lokungena eyunivesithi ngokusebenzisa iindondo ezihlakaniphileyo ze-AI njengetyala lobugebenga, emva kokuba abafundi abathathu babanjwa benxiba ezi zixhobo ngethuba lovavanyo lokubhala eziyunivesithi zaseSeoul. Ukusukela ngo-2027, abo babanjwa baya kuvinjelwa kuviwo iminyaka emithathu, endaweni yonyaka omnye, kwaye abahloli baya kubekwa kuzo zonke izikhungo zovavanyo ezingama-1 312 ukujonga iindondo ezirhanelekileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Luphawu olucacileyo lwendlela izixhobo ze-AI evelisayo ezigqitha ngayo ngokukhawuleza imithetho yengqibelelo yovavanyo ehlabathini (intsika 1), kunye nesikhumbuzo sokuba ukubona kunye nesohlwayo yinxalenye kuphela yempendulo eziyunivesithi kunye neenkqubo ziya kuyidinga.

Times Higher Education · Established press

entry.title: AI Article Reviews Dominate Human Peer Reviews at Their Best: Evidence and Policy Choices
entry.summary:
UGary King noSteven Worthington bokwiHarvard Institute for Quantitative Social Science bathelekise uphononongo lwabangqina (peer review) olubhalwe yi-AI noluphononongo lwabantu olungu-134 kuma-manuscript angu-124 aqokelelwe phakathi ko-2019 no-2026. Babika ukuba uphononongo olwenziwe yi-Claude Opus 4.8 lwadlula uphononongo lwabantu kuzo zonke iinqanaba abalwakhayo, lwagwetywa ngokuba luchanekile ngakumbi kuvavanyo lwabo, kwaye lukhethwe ngabahleli bamajenali abathathu abadala kolukhulu uphononongo lokuthelekiswa olubhekisa ngqo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Umceli mngeni ocingisisiweyo osekelwe kwidata ngendlela i-AI evelisayo esetyenziswa ngayo kwisenzo semfundo ephakamileyo, ingaphelelanga kwigumbi lokufundisa kuphela (intsika 1): ukuba i-AI inakho ukuphonononga uphando kakuhle, iiyunivesithi namajenali afuna umgaqo-nkqubo wokuba usetyenziswa njani kwaye nini, ingekuko nje ukuba uvalwe.

Institute for Quantitative Social Science, Harvard University · University working paper

entry.title: Proposal 14: Student outcomes indicators
entry.summary:
Umlawuli wemfundo ephakamileyo yaseNgilane, i-Office for Students, ucebisa ukutshintsha umda wawonke-wonke wokuphumelela kwabafundi abaphumelele izidanga, ngokusebenzisa iinkomba ezintathu eziqhathaniswayo kwi-Teaching Excellence Framework yayo: ukuqhubeka ngomsebenzi okanye ukufunda, imali abaphumelele izidanga bayifumana xa kuthelekiswa nemigangatho yesizwe, kunye nokuba abaphumelele izidanga bathi basebenzisa oko bakufundileyo, ngokutyhila kophando lwe-Graduate Outcomes. Le migangatho izakulungelelaniswa ngokwecandelo lesifundo, indawo, iziqinisekiso zokungena, kunye neemeko zoqoqosho zabafundi, kunokusebenzisa umda omnye omiselweyo kuzo zonke izifundo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Lo ngumlinge wangoku kumbuzo ophambili wentsika 5: ukuba inkqubo yedata eyakhiwe ngeenkomba ezininzi eziqhathaniswayo, kunomda omnye obanzi wesizwe, inakho ukugweba ngokufanelekileyo kwaye iphucule iziphumo zemfundo ephakamileyo.

Office for Students (OfS) · National regulator consultation

entry.title: UCT engineering pairs AI-enabled early warning with a multilingual support hub to lift student success
entry.summary:
Abaphandi e-Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment kwi-University of Cape Town bachaza iProjekthi yempumelelo yabafundi edibanisa uqeqesho lokuqwalasela umngcipheko kwangethuba, ukuxhaswa koontanga kunye nendawo yenkxaso esekwe kwimininingwane kwaye esebenzisa i-AI. Indawo le ihambelana nesichazi-magama sezilwimi ezininzi esikwi-isiXhosa, iSesotho, iKiswahili kunye nesiBhulu, esijongana nokubekelwa bucala kolwimi ngaxeshanye nomngcipheko wezifundo. Isahluko sivela kuConstellations of Hope, ingxelo yeClub of Rome ephathelele kufundo oluguqula ubomi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Umzekelo waseMzantsi Afrika ongqinisekisiweyo, ophathekayo, wohlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi (iNtsika 2) owakhelwe ngaphezu kolingano lwezilwimi ezininzi, ubonisa ukuba imininingwane yesilumkiso kwangethuba incede abafundi kuphela ukuba inkxaso elandelayo nayo ithetha ulwimi lwabo.

Globethics Publications (Club of Rome report) · Peer-reviewed book chapter

entry.title: AI literacy alone does not create graduate opportunity, Nigerian study of 450 students finds; technology readiness is what matters
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwabafundi beyunivesithi base-Nigeria abali-450 lufumanisa ukuba imfundo yoshishino kunye nengqibelelo ye-AI zombini ziphucula ukulungela kobuxhakaxhaka kwabafundi, kwaye kukulungela oku okuchongayo ukuba ngaba abafundi baguqula izixhobo ze-AI zibe ngamashishini amancinci okwenyani. Ukunqongophala kweemfuno okuqikelelwayo kuthoba ngqo isenzo soshishino sabaphumelele izidanga, kodwa kuqinisa unxulumano phakathi kokulungela kunye nesenzo xa abafundi sele benezo zixhobo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ubungqina obungqalileyo kwiNtsika 4: ukufikelela kwi-AI kuphela akudali amathuba kubaphumelele izidanga kwiindawo eziswele izixhobo; kwakhiwa izakhono kunye nokulungela kobuxhakaxhaka okuguqula ingqibelelo ye-AI ibe yindlela yokuphila.

Journal of Entrepreneurship in Emerging Economies · Peer-reviewed journal article
